-- users 사용자
CREATE TABLE "users" (
  "id" INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  
  "emp_no" varchar(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  "email" varchar(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  "department_id" int NOT NULL,
  "position_id" int NOT NULL,
  "role" varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  "name" varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  "birth_date" date NOT NULL,
  "phone_no" varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  "status" varchar NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
  "address" varchar(255),
  "zipcode" varchar(30),
  "hire_date" date NOT NULL,
  "resign_date" date,
  "bank_name" varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  "bank_account" varchar(30) NOT NULL,
  "account_holder" varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp,
  "updated_at" timestamp
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON "users" ("emp_no");

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON "users" ("email");

CREATE INDEX ON "users" ("department_id");

CREATE INDEX ON "users" ("status");

ALTER TABLE "users" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("department_id") REFERENCES "departments" ("id");

ALTER TABLE "users" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("position_id") REFERENCES "positions" ("id");

--테이블 생성 확인
SELECT
  column_name,
  data_type,
  character_maximum_length,
  is_nullable,
  column_default
FROM
  information_schema.columns
WHERE
  table_name = 'users';
  
-- DEPARTMENT  부서 코드
CREATE TABLE "departments" (
  "id" SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  "dept_code" varchar(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  "dept_name" varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  "description" varchar(255),
  "created_at" timestamp,
  "updated_at" timestamp
);

SELECT
  column_name,
  data_type,
  character_maximum_length,
  is_nullable,
  column_default
FROM
  information_schema.columns
WHERE
  table_name = 'departments';
  
-- POSITIONS 직급 코드
CREATE TABLE positions (
    id INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, -- SERIAL 대신 INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY 사용
    position_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    position_level INT NOT NULL,
    description VARCHAR(255),
    created_at TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP
);

-- ATTENDANCE 근태
CREATE TABLE "attendance" (
  "id" SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  "user_id" int NOT NULL,
  "leave_request_id" int,
  "attendance_date" date NOT NULL,
  "clock_in_time" timestamp,
  "clock_out_time" timestamp,
  "attendance_status" varchar(50),
  "description" varchar(255),
  "created_at" timestamp,
  "updated_at" timestamp
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON "attendance" ("user_id", "attendance_date");

SELECT
  column_name,
  data_type,
  character_maximum_length,
  is_nullable,
  column_default
FROM
  information_schema.columns
WHERE
  table_name = 'attendance';
  
ALTER TABLE "attendance" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES "users" ("id");

ALTER TABLE "attendance" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("leave_request_id") REFERENCES "leave_request" ("id");

-- PERSONAL_LEAVE 개인연차
CREATE TABLE personal_leave (
    id INT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, 
    user_id INT NOT NULL, 
    year INT NOT NULL,
    total_leave_days NUMERIC(3,1) NOT NULL, 
    --원래는 decimal(2,1)이었는데 총 두자리 수만 가능한 이슈가 있었음
    --예를들면 9.1 가능, 10.1 불가능 이어서 수정함.
    used_leave_days NUMERIC(3,1) DEFAULT 0, 
    remain_leave_days NUMERIC(3,1) DEFAULT 0,
    created_at TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP,
    UNIQUE (user_id, year)
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ON "personal_leave" ("user_id", "year");

ALTER TABLE "personal_leave" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES "users" ("id");

--LEAVE_REQUEST 휴가 신청
CREATE TABLE "leave_request" (
  "id" SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  "user_id" int NOT NULL,
  "approval_id" int NOT NULL,
  "leave_type" varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  "start_date" date NOT NULL,
  "end_date" date NOT NULL,
  "reason" varchar(100),
  "leave_days_used" decimal(2,1),
  "created_at" timestamp,
  "updated_at" timestamp
);

CREATE INDEX ON "leave_request" ("user_id");

CREATE INDEX ON "leave_request" ("start_date", "end_date");

ALTER TABLE "leave_request" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("user_id") REFERENCES "users" ("id");

ALTER TABLE "leave_request" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("approval_id") REFERENCES "approvals" ("id");

-- APPROVALS  결재
CREATE TABLE "approvals" (
  "id" SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  "requester_id" int NOT NULL,
  "approver_id" int NOT NULL,
  "approval_status" varchar(20),
  "approval_name" varchar(100),
  "approval_type" varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  "pending_time" timestamp,
  "approved_time" timestamp,
  "rejected_time" timestamp,
  "created_at" timestamp,
  "updated_at" timestamp
);

CREATE INDEX ON "approvals" ("requester_id", "approval_status");

ALTER TABLE "approvals" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("requester_id") REFERENCES "users" ("id");

ALTER TABLE "approvals" ADD FOREIGN KEY ("approver_id") REFERENCES "users" ("id");
